$Comment: The worked example of a two-step haul: mine a seam's worth, then hand a share of it back at the board. Tune each step by the name it carries, and keep the delivered count well under the gathered one so the player keeps most of the ore. For an ore the mined block and the returned item share an id, which is why both steps name the same thing. The board entry's AcceptRequires asks for Mining 25 in place of the Normal band's combat level, so a miner qualifies on Mining alone; leave AcceptRequires out to use the band's gate, or write {} to open the contract to everyone.
